CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
Pancasila and the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. The State holds the view that all forms of violence, especially domestic violence, constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity as well as forms of discrimination.

The State's view is based on Article 28 of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, along with its amendments. Article 28G paragraph (1) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia stipulates that "Every person shall have the right to protection of self, family, honor, dignity, and property under his/her control, and shall have the right to a sense of security and protection from the threat of fear to do or not do something which is a basic right". Article 28H paragraph (2) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia stipulates that "Every person shall have the right to obtain facilities and special treatment to obtain the same opportunities and benefits in order to achieve equality and justice".

Current developments show that acts of physical, psychological, sexual violence, and domestic neglect in reality occur so that adequate legal instruments are needed to eliminate violence, especially domestic violence. Legal reform that sides with vulnerable or subordinated groups, especially women and children, becomes very necessary in connection with the many cases of violence, especially domestic violence, this also occurs in South Tangerang City, in 2010 violence cases reported to the Tangerang Police totaled 143 cases, at the South Jakarta Metro Police 56 cases were recorded, Tigaraksa Police - 19 - Tangerang Regency 23 cases and in 2011 70 cases were recorded at the South Jakarta Metro Police and 28 cases at the Tigaraksa Police Tangerang Regency, this does not yet reflect the actual conditions in society, because cases of violence especially those occurring within the household are still considered disgraceful in the view of society and also the courage of the community to report incidents still needs to be increased, therefore a regional regulation on the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence needs to be possessed by South Tangerang City.

The emergence of cases of violence against children and women is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, social environment and others. Therefore, victims of such violence need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights. From the above framework, the Regional Government is responsible for taking actions both legally, politically, economically and socially to suppress, prevent, reduce and eliminate all forms of violence against children and women.

In conducting guidance, development and protection of women and children, the role of society is needed, whether through women and children protection institutions, religious institutions, non-governmental organizations, community organizations, social organizations, business world, mass media, or educational institutions.

This Regional Regulation on the Protection of Women and Children from violence is closely related to several other laws and regulations already in force, among others, Law Number 1 of 1946 concerning the Criminal Code and its Amendments, Law Number 8 of 1981 concerning the Criminal Procedure Code, Law Number 1 of 1974 concerning Marriage, Law Number 7 of 1984 concerning Ratification of the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women, Law Number 39 of 1999 concerning Human - 20 - Rights and most importantly Law number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence and Law number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection.

This Regional Regulation, in addition to regulating matters of prevention and protection as well as recovery for victims of violence, also regulates matters of obligations for law enforcement officers, health workers, social workers, volunteer companions, or spiritual counselors to protect victims so that they are more sensitive and responsive. To carry out violence prevention, Agencies or Offices that have duties and responsibilities related to the field of women's empowerment and child protection implement preventive actions, among others, organizing communication, information, and education about violence prevention, protection of women and children.

Based on these considerations, it is time to establish a Regional Regulation in South Tangerang City concerning the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence, especially Domestic Violence, which is regulated comprehensively, clearly, and firmly to protect and side with victims, as well as simultaneously provide education and awareness to the community and officials that all acts of violence constitute crimes against human dignity.
1.1.rationale: The passages explicitly reference domestic violence as a key form of violence addressed by the regulation, including the need for legal instruments to eliminate it and the regulation’s focus on protecting victims, especially in the household context.
